# Number

## Summary
Base-realm field. Lives at `https://cardstack.com/base/number` (default export). Primitive numeric field (float). For percentages use Percentage; for money use Amount with Currency; for counts the catalog Quantity.

## Usage
```ts
import NumberField from 'https://cardstack.com/base/number';
```

Example: value `42` or `3.14`
